about: Frozen labelled HOLDOUT for the chat 'looks like a bug' suggestion classifier (slack-messages-to-bug-reports-2026-10-05 P-007). Written by su-dab96471 on 2026-10-06 BEFORE chat-bug-suggest.ts existed, and never used for tuning: the classifier is tuned on chat-bug-suggest-tuning.json only. Label bug=true means the author reports that software misbehaves for them (error, crash, wrong result, data loss, not loading, hanging, regression). bug=false covers how-to questions, feature requests, announcements (including of fixed bugs), reviews, plans and chat. Self-authored, so its numbers measure the classifier against one author's idea of Slack traffic, not live precision. If the classifier is changed to pass this file, the file stops being a holdout: write a fresh one.
